purpose: Priority 2 evidence-gap assessments; not executable guidance.

verified_evidence: biodata-amendment:service - The historical manual lists name, gender, entry code, birth-certificate number, ID number, birth year and citizenship amendments.
biodata-amendment:official-query-route - The public query page directs examination queries through heads of institutions and Sub-County Directors of Education.

biodata-amendment:historical-submission - The September 2017 manual describes selecting biodata amendment, entering examination identity, reviewing the existing details, entering the proposed correction, attaching the requested documents and submitting. This is historical workflow evidence, not confirmation of current eligibility or screens.
The official query table defines multiple capture-error categories; the 2026 charter and captured query page provide conflicting deadline and penalty evidence that remains gated.
missing_evidence: Current eligibility by amendment type and examination.
Current document checklist and QMIS screens.
Exact deadline and penalty by examination, year and triggering event.
assessments.safe_current_response: Do not quote an unscoped deadline, fee or penalty. Clarify the service and examination; if the controlling rule remains unresolved, use controlled escalation to the verified KNEC switchboard.

verified_evidence: results-query:service - The historical manual identifies absentee appeals, missing marks and reinstatement queries.
results-query:official-query-route - The public query page directs examination queries through heads of institutions and Sub-County Directors of Education.
The query table distinguishes mark, subject, registration-pending, irregularity-pending and cancellation categories; the QMIS guide documents generic submission and status tracking.
The charter provides examination-family late-query charges, but calendar-day versus working-day wording remains unresolved.
missing_evidence: Exact deadline and penalty by examination and result type.
assessments.safe_current_response: Do not quote an unscoped deadline, fee or penalty. Clarify the service and examination; if the controlling rule remains unresolved, use controlled escalation to the verified KNEC switchboard.

verified_evidence: direct-recovery:service - The historical manual describes recovery of missing or spoilt results slips, certificates and examination printouts.
direct-recovery:official-query-route - The public query page directs examination queries through heads of institutions and Sub-County Directors of Education.
The query table distinguishes recovery of certificates and results slips, while the QMIS guide documents Direct Recovery submission and status tracking.
The charter supplies a dispatch-based certificate-query window, which is not generalized to loss after collection.
missing_evidence: Current eligibility for slips, certificates and printouts.
assessments.safe_current_response: Do not quote an unscoped deadline, fee or penalty. Clarify the service and examination; if the controlling rule remains unresolved, use controlled escalation to the verified KNEC switchboard.

verified_evidence: photo-amendment:service - The historical manual identifies photo correction as a separate query.
The September 2017 guide documents the photo-amendment screen sequence, upload control, Required List attachments and submission; the 2018 guide documents generic tracking.
missing_evidence: Applicable fee or penalty, if any.
assessments.safe_current_response: Do not quote an unscoped deadline, fee or penalty. Clarify the service and examination; if the controlling rule remains unresolved, use controlled escalation to the verified KNEC switchboard.

verified_evidence: The six-page 2018 guide documents access, registration, login, home-page menus, query categories, generic submission, status lookup, post-verification payment notification and email/SMS collection notification.
The September 2017 external manual documents registration, login, password recovery and screen sequences for biodata, photo, contracted-professional payment and confirmation queries.
Both guides document status lookup; neither supplies a complete glossary for every possible live status label.
missing_evidence: Current official confirmation that the historical screen labels and sequences remain applicable.
Current official status-label glossary and error/correction guidance.
Current live behavior for failed registration email, password recovery, attachment and submission.
assessments.safe_current_response: Explain the exact workflow documented by the guides, label it as guide-based, never claim access to an individual account, and distinguish unverified live-portal applicability or undefined status labels.

verified_evidence: professional-payment-query:service - The historical manual includes nonpayment, underpayment and overpayment queries for contracted professionals.
The September 2017 guide documents examination, year, series, position, issue nature, expected and received amounts, workplace, description and Required List attachments.
The 2026 charter records contracted-personnel obligations but does not establish a payment-query resolution period.
missing_evidence: Payment investigation timelines and escalation ownership.
assessments.safe_current_response: Do not quote an unscoped deadline, fee or penalty. Clarify the service and examination; if the controlling rule remains unresolved, use controlled escalation to the verified KNEC switchboard.
